summary.name: Luxury Editorial
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit direction: highlight one subject with refined display type, concise copy, generous space, selective image cropping and restrained color. Material highlights are used sparingly. Luxury must not be equated with excessive gold, sparkle or blur.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit fit: product and editorial introductions led by one subject. Inferred from the pairings: fashion, hospitality, invitations, premium product reveals, lookbooks and property showcases. Gallery use requires an actual image set with captions.
summary.limitations: Best used alone rather than hybridized; add a letterpress title moment or measured depth on cropped imagery only when needed. Avoid metallic bevels, gold gradients, glitter, heavy depth blur, fast multi-axis parallax and exposed layer edges. Cropping cannot extract subjects or fill missing artwork.
summary.palette: Background policy is scene_dependent: choose it from subject, environment, lighting and mood. The status is a style-compatible suggestion for new artwork, not an approved palette. Illustrative tokens are background #F4EFE7, foreground #29251F and accent #817159. Foreground on background measures 13.308:1 and passes normal text. Accent on background measures 4.132:1 and is decorative only. Task-provided exact colors override these tokens, and gradients are disabled.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit motion: smooth camera moves, subtle parallax and precise settling. Suggested rule: one camera move per scene with a measured ease-out. Optional references are motion-012 chapter handoff, motion-013 card track, motion-015 story steps, motion-018 captioned curved gallery and motion-038 punctuation zoom, which needs a real mark in the scene. Video is authored on composition time; interactive versions need reduced-motion static states.
summary.audio: Unspecified by the style, and the audio direction is open. Silence, restrained ambience or music can each fit without a mandated genre, tempo or voice. Music or narration must not compete with essential copy. Gallery previews stay silent. No audio was supplied or created here, and beat sync requires real audio analysis.
summary.assetRequirements: Requires supplied or authored imagery and the subject's exact copy; photographic assets must never be assumed. Use loaded local fonts, image masks and measured spacing. Optional crops must preserve originals and record crop recipes. Punctuation zoom needs the scene's real mark. Specific fonts, image dimensions and image counts are unspecified.
summary.combinations: Optional style-052 adds a shallow letterpress deboss for title cards only, with ink #29251F and #817159 limited to one rule or monogram; avoid paper texture on every scene. Optional style-101 adds 2.5D parallax of cropped supplied layers, one slow move per scene, capped displacement, no heavy blur and a static fallback under reduced motion.
summary.productionApproach: HyperFrames is the default pipeline, using a paused GSAP timeline registered in window.__timelines, with check and snapshot validation before delivery render. Remotion applies only under its documented fallback condition. HTML/CSS and SVG are the style renderers, GSAP is the motion engine, and Motion is optional with explicit synchronization. chroma-js validates colors; PhotoSwipe and Cropper.js are optional supporting tools. Source review covered only sampled seconds 1–8, without audio.
